limitations: This is an independent model-agent static/offline review, not a human review or evidence of live-model quality. Reviewer real model calls and tokens are zero.

The 90-second delay is evaluator-injected flow time, not actual model transport latency and not an extra model call. The outer evaluation ledger has no pending reservation during this delay; production core has already created its internal spend.reserve/chargeCall state before entering the injected chat callback. Both arms use the same delay rule with their specified receipt operation.

The subscribed CLI has opaque wrapping and no provider-enforced output cap. Admission reserves serialized UTF-8 input bytes plus at least 128000 output tokens and 16384 wrapper tokens. Actual measured input plus output is authoritative; unknown/conflicting usage or a measured overage fails the gate and stops further dispatch.

A missing observation or no subsequent dispatch does not create a receipt or authorize a forced delay. The audit must verify actual receipt/event identity and wait endpoints; no_matching_receipt is not evidence that the timing condition was exercised.

Budget or initial-acceptance failure may leave later branches or revision phases incomplete. No automatic retry, rerun, extra probe, second model, formal evaluation or installation replacement is authorized.

Gold and author-script bytes are hashed for integrity, but the executor neither imports their labels nor executes authoring code. Business correctness does not prove mechanism execution; actual phase-local receipts, source exposure and acceptance transitions are required.

Six synthetic pairs cannot establish population noninferiority. Protocol shape and receipt operation can reveal implementation despite omitted arm labels in the audit packet. Unknown or zero denominators remain unestimable.
